events.title: Dark Eyes – Super Soldier 2 Joins Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: We're excited to announce that Dark Eyes – Super Soldier 2 is participating in Steam Next Fest! Get ready for intense 2D sci-fi combat, massive battles between the Earth Space Defense Force and the alien Delma (AKA Dark Eyes), and a story-driven military campaign.The demo is already available to play now!Jump into the action, experience the battlefield, and let us know what you think.If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to wishlist Dark Eyes – Super Soldier 2 to support the game and stay informed

events.title: Gameplay Trailer 60 FPS
events.summary: Hey everyone!A while back I mentioned the gameplay trailer on Youtube. Recently I noticed it was only on 24 FPS. So I reuploaded it with the 60 frames per second!!! Ow yeahhh....Enjoy the remastered experience!Trailer: Gameplay Trailer Dark Eyes - Super Soldier HIGH QUALITY

events.title: Sarge Explains!
events.summary: “LISTEN UP, SKINNY BOY!”The Dark Eyes are at our doorstep.And they'd love nothing more than to rip out your guts, marinate 'em, cook 'em, and have you for dinner!Lucky for you, I'm here to keep your sorry ass alive and teach you what we're up against.Check out all the Sarge toturials on my YT channel: SARGE EXPLAINS - Dark Eye GruntSARGE EXPLAINS - Dark Eye EnforcerSARGE EXPLAINS - DARK EYE CONDUITSARGE EXPLAINS - DARK EYE SWARM... and more releasing this week and the next!!!

events.title: Demo Update
events.summary: Hey all!Just uploaded a new demo.Fixed some issues Shield pickup is now stored when you die (previously you would lose it on reloading checkpoint)Some issue on the hiding mechanic is fixedDelma Grenade launcher icon was incorrect and has been replacedNew featuresArea in which you had to evade turret fire has been turned into small boss fightComic previews have been updated (enhanced with AI)Mission select menu (so you can replay a specific mission)Graphic detail selected (on high by default)

events.title: The Super Soldier is Back!
events.summary: Hey Everyone!Dark Eyes - Super Soldier is coming back with a fresh new part 2! In this part the story of the super soldier continues in the war between the Earth Space Defense Force and the Dark Eyes (AKA Delma).You get to experience more epic battles, face new enemies, and get to use more advanced weapons than before.
